text: People ask how I decide when to stop negotiating. I walk away from a stalled deal rather than discount. Discounting to close teaches the buyer that waiting works, and you pay for that lesson on every deal afterwards. The number I actually watch is cost per store: below 1,200 a store never reaches breakeven, so we stop. I will not sign anything before I have that figure for the specific site.
author: A. Example

text: Something I have changed my mind about. These days I would rather find a local partner than open our own store. I used to think ownership was the only way to hold a standard. I have not worked out how to square that with the cost-per-store rule, because a partner's numbers are not mine to see.
author: A. Example
